stories.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4

sources.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_zh: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更
sources.title_en: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_original: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.summary:
Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, Apple no longer includes Intel (x86_64) code in some of the system binaries and libraries that CodeQL relies on to trace builds. As…
Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, Apple no longer includes Intel (x86_64) code in some of the system binaries and libraries that CodeQL relies on to trace builds. As a result, CodeQL can’t support traced scans on these versions or analyze Swift 6.4.
If you scan Swift or use traced builds for other languages, pin your workflow
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 从 macOS 27 和 Xcode 27 起，Apple 不再在 CodeQL 依赖的部分系统二进制和库中保留 Intel x86_64 代码，导致 CodeQL 无法在这些版本上执行 traced 扫描，也无法分析 Swift 6.4；文章建议把工作流分别固定到 macOS 26 与 Xcode 26 及更早版本，C/C++、C#、Java 可改用 build mode none 绕过。

en.reason: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java.

stories.title: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍 / Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours

sources.title: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍 / Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍
sources.title_en: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_original: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.summary: Anthropic 发布内部研究称，技术部门初级岗位占比从 2025 年初的 21% 降至 14%，新招初级占比从 27% 降至 9%，空缺初级职位降至 6%，非技术部门基本稳定。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic内部研究显示，新员工中初级职位占比从27%降至9%，到2026年8月其AI agents工作时长已达人类的六倍，工程师代码提交量增至5.1倍，研究者Nolan Lovett警告这将导致资深人才断档。

en.summary: Anthropic published internal research showing that the share of junior roles in its technical organization fell from 21% in early 2025 to 14%, the share of new junior hires dropped from 27% to 9%, and open junior positions fell to 6%, while non-technical departments remained largely stable.
en.reason: Anthropic’s research found technical junior roles dropping from 21% to 14% and new-hire junior share from 27% to 9%, while AI agents worked six times human hours by August 2026, and Nolan Lovett warned of a senior-talent pipeline gap.

stories.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say

sources.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_zh: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责
sources.title_en: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_original: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.summary: 慕尼黑地区法院 I 五月底裁定 Google 的 AI 搜索摘要属于公司自己的陈述而非中立转述，Google 须为错误内容担责；Google 公开宣布上诉后实际以和解结案，未获上级法院裁决。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Aachen Regional Court在2026年9月24日裁决中沿用Munich法院逻辑，认定Google的AI把本属他人的性侵指控错安到一位医生身上，AI答案即公司自身内容。

en.summary: Munich Regional Court I ruled in late May that Google's AI search summaries count as the company's own statements rather than neutral retransmission, making Google liable for erroneous content. After publicly announcing an appeal, Google in fact settled the case, so no higher court ever ruled on it.
en.reason: Aachen Regional Court’s 24 September 2026 ruling, following Munich Regional Court’s late-May logic, held Google liable because its AI overview wrongly attributed another person’s sexual-assault allegation to a doctor, treating AI answers as Google’s own content.

sources.summary:
Harness 工程是否正在变得“过度”？
Harness 工程是否正在变得“过度”？
本文字数：4051 字
阅读完需：约 13 分钟
Harness² 是谷歌开源的可插拔智能体框架，通过动态调整提示词、记忆、工具指导等8类外部组件实现无需微调模型的递归能力演进。
支持 OpenCode/Codex 双后端，Apache 2.0 协议，定位为研究原型而非生产产品；组件化设计明确分离上下文构建、工具调度与任务委派逻辑；实测在视觉任务中接入 Jev 1.14 后显著提升表现。
适合 AI 架构师、Agent 系统开发者、大模型应用工程师阅读。
谷歌研究团队开源了一套名为 Harness² 的智能体框架，试图让 AI Agent 在不修改模型权重的情况下，通过持续调整系统提示词、记忆、工具指导、skill、子智能体等外部组件，实现递归式能力提升。
目前，Harness² 已在 GitHub 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源，支持 OpenCode 和 Codex，默认使用 OpenCode，也可以切换至 Codex。Google Research 同时强调，Harness² 仍属于研究项
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 谷歌以Apache 2.0开源Harness²，支持OpenCode/Codex，拆出系统提示词等8类组件，在WorkBuddy-Bench上不调模型权重最高提升11.5分，国内开发者Joseph Zhou接入Jev 1.14实测视觉任务提升。

en.title: Google open-sources Harness with support for OpenCode and Codex: a developer in China hooked it up to Jev and found it "really works" in testing
en.summary:
Is Harness engineering becoming “excessive”?

Harness² is Google’s open-source pluggable agent framework, which enables recursive capability evolution without fine-tuning the model by dynamically adjusting eight categories of external components, including prompts, memory, and tool guidance.

It supports both OpenCode and Codex backends under the Apache 2.0 license and is positioned as a research prototype rather than a production product; its componentized design cleanly separates context construction, tool orchestration, and task delegation logic; in tests, plugging in Jev 1.14 markedly improved performance on visual tasks.

Suited for AI architects, Agent system developers, and LLM application engineers.

Google Research has open-sourced an agent framework called Harness² that aims to let AI Agents achieve recursive capability gains without modifying model weights, by continuously adjusting external components such as system prompts, memory, tool guidance, skills, and sub-agents.

Harness² is now open-sourced on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license, supporting OpenCode and Codex — OpenCode by default, with the option to switch to Codex. Google Research also emphasizes that Harness² remains a research project.
en.reason: Google open-sourced Harness² under Apache 2.0 with OpenCode/Codex backends and eight pluggable components, reporting up to 11.5 points gain on WorkBuddy-Bench without weight tuning, while developer Joseph Zhou's Jev 1.14 test showed visual-task improvements.

谷歌研究团队开源了一套名为 Harness² 的智能体框架，试图让 AI Agent 在不修改模型权重的情况下，通过持续调整系统提示词、记忆、工具指导、skill、子智能体等外部组件，实现递归式能力提升。
目前，Harness² 已在 GitHub 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源，支持 OpenCode 和 Codex，默认使用 OpenCode，也可以切换至 Codex。Google Research 同时强调，Harness² 仍属于研究项

en.title: Google open-sources Harness with support for OpenCode and Codex: a developer in China hooked it up to Jev and found it "really works" in testing
en.summary:
Is Harness engineering becoming “excessive”?

Harness² is Google’s open-source pluggable agent framework, which enables recursive capability evolution without fine-tuning the model by dynamically adjusting eight categories of external components, including prompts, memory, and tool guidance.

It supports both OpenCode and Codex backends under the Apache 2.0 license and is positioned as a research prototype rather than a production product; its componentized design cleanly separates context construction, tool orchestration, and task delegation logic; in tests, plugging in Jev 1.14 markedly improved performance on visual tasks.

Suited for AI architects, Agent system developers, and LLM application engineers.

Google Research has open-sourced an agent framework called Harness² that aims to let AI Agents achieve recursive capability gains without modifying model weights, by continuously adjusting external components such as system prompts, memory, tool guidance, skills, and sub-agents.

Harness² is now open-sourced on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license, supporting OpenCode and Codex — OpenCode by default, with the option to switch to Codex. Google Research also emphasizes that Harness² remains a research project.
en.reason: Google open-sourced Harness² under Apache 2.0 with OpenCode/Codex backends and eight pluggable components, reporting up to 11.5 points gain on WorkBuddy-Bench without weight tuning, while developer Joseph Zhou's Jev 1.14 test showed visual-task improvements.

en.title: Seeing so many people enjoy this game demo puts my mind at ease. That said, Codex+Unreal isn't the optimal solution—Unreal built a skill specifically for Claude Code, which gives Claude a higher development ceiling. We have hit some bottlenecks, though: LLMs can't handle Control Rig well, especially complex attack animations. Anyone got a good solution?
en.reason: A game demo drawing positive reactions faces a development bottleneck: Unreal has built a dedicated skill for Claude Code, yet large language models still fail at Control Rig work like complex attack animations, and the developer is asking the community for solutions.

en.title: DoorDash's Flux Runs 130,000 Engineering Tasks on Cloud Agents
en.summary:
DoorDash has moved its engineering agent workloads off developers' laptops and onto its Flux cloud platform. In one month, the platform automated 130,000 engineering tasks and now supports more than 25,000 automated code reviews a week. Flux runs agent workflows on isolated Firecracker microVMs with an MCP gateway, reusable Playbooks, and multiple trigger types, using scoped permissions and centralized auditing.

DoorDash migrated its engineering agent workloads from developers' local laptops to its in-house Flux cloud platform, automating 130,000 tasks a month and 25,000 code reviews a week. Through isolated sandboxes, an MCP gateway, reusable Playbooks, and multiple entry points for triggering runs, the platform addresses the compute bottlenecks, uncontrolled security exposure, and lack of observability that come with local execution.
en.reason: DoorDash moved engineering agent workloads off developer laptops onto its Flux cloud platform, automating 130,000 engineering tasks in one month and supporting over 25,000 automated code reviews weekly via isolated Firecracker microVMs, an MCP gateway and centralized audit.

en.title: At a time when a growing number of LLM companies are winning large user bases with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image or video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason is its extremely focused strategy: it has deliberately given up these popular directions, concentrating nearly all of its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).
en.reason: DeepSeek has not released image or video generation as standalone features; founder Liang Wenfeng says 3D generation, video generation and world models are excluded because AGI is the 'watermelon' beyond such 'sesame' pursuits, with multimodality kept as a component.

en.title: If you're not running your own LLM agent, how do you know what's going on inside it?

sources.title: 如果你没有运行自己的 LLM 代理，你怎么知道里面发生了什么？ / If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.title_zh: 如果你没有运行自己的 LLM 代理，你怎么知道里面发生了什么？
sources.title_en: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.title_original: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者主张自建LLM proxy，以多provider多模型单端点和记录key调用模型/客户端/时间/状态为例，并称cache miss可20秒手工定位。

en.reason: Running your own LLM proxy gives a single endpoint across multiple providers and models while logging each key's calls with model, client, time and status, so the author says a cache miss can be manually traced in 20 seconds.

sources.title: 如果你不自己搭一个 LLM 代理，又怎么知道到底发生了什么？ / If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.title_zh: 如果你不自己搭一个 LLM 代理，又怎么知道到底发生了什么？
sources.title_en: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.title_original: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hacker News 上的这篇帖文追问：不自建 LLM proxy 如何掌握模型的实际行为？评论区 voodooEntity 回应称，自己搭建 agent/harness 正是为了获得完整可观测性，看清它在做什么、为什么这么做。

en.reason: A Hacker News post asks how anyone who doesn't run their own LLM proxy can know what a model is actually doing, and commenter voodooEntity says building an agent/harness gave full observability into its actions and reasons.

stories.title: 感谢大家的支持，lemo-opuscar 已经破3K star啦！！！3000星感谢视频献给支持这个项目的朋友。 lemo-opuscar是我给claude做的一个视频风格库，里面的风格从最早的39种，到现在已经更新到51种了。另外已经做完和正在做的还有不少，会持续更新。 我不是一个喜欢吹嘘的人，说实话，这个项目的初衷是为了给大家提供更多风格方面的参考，同时在opus降智的时候，能更加稳定的出片。里面搭配的现成的工具也会让视频制作更容…

en.title: Thanks for all the support — lemo-opuscar has just passed 3K stars!
en.reason: lemo-opuscar, a video style library built for Claude, has passed 3,000 stars while growing from 39 to 51 styles, and its creator explains the aim of offering style references and steadier output when Opus underperforms, plus why other models need extra tuning.

AI 正在重写软件研发流程，也把研发组织推到了变化的前沿。因此， “AI 原生组织” 一词变得很热，但热度并不是我们此刻开口的理由。
阿里云 CTO 产研线围绕业务北极星目标展开的实践已经取得了一些局部成果，也开始暴露出更难的问题：当 AI 原生实践走入深水区，单点提效和局部最优远远不够。因为研发团队从来不是一个孤立系统，它嵌在业务、组织与产业协作之中。我们决定不等答案成熟，在探索仍在进行时公开分享真实的进展、困惑与未解之题。希望与更多研发组织相互验证、彼此激发，一起把“AI 原生研发组织”从一个“吸睛概念”，形成新的组织范式。
本文对云栖大会《AI 原生研发组织论坛》做一个简单的回顾，对一些精彩的观点和有用的实践，做一个总结。由于篇幅关系，本文从组织纬度进行回顾，另有 7 个落
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 阿里云CTO产研线公开7个AI原生研发组织样板间：有项目把全链路处理从2小时缩至5分钟、发布周期从40天缩至2天，也讨论Agent进组织后的协作难题。

en.title: Alibaba Cloud's 7 showcase teams explore AI-native R&D organization practices
en.summary:
AI is rewriting the software R&D process and pushing R&D organizations to the forefront of change. As a result, the term "AI-native organization" has become a hot topic—but buzz alone isn't why we're speaking up now.

AI is rewriting the software R&D process and pushing R&D organizations to the forefront of change. As a result, the term "AI-native organization" has become a hot topic—but buzz alone isn't why we're speaking up now.

Length: 10,421 characters
Reading time: about 34 minutes

AI is rewriting the software R&D process and pushing R&D organizations to the forefront of change. As a result, the term "AI-native organization" has become a hot topic—but buzz alone isn't why we're speaking up now.

The work of the Alibaba Cloud CTO's product and engineering organization around the business's North Star goals has already produced some localized results, and is starting to expose harder questions: once AI-native practice moves into deep water, point-solution efficiency gains and local optima are nowhere near enough. Because an R&D team is never an isolated system—it is embedded in the business, the organization, and industry collaboration. We decided not to wait until the answers are mature, and instead to openly share real progress, confusion, and unresolved questions while the exploration is still underway. We hope to cross-validate and spark ideas with more R&D organizations, and together turn the "AI-native R&D organization" from an eye-catching concept into a new organizational paradigm.

This article offers a brief recap of the Apsara Conference's AI-Native R&D Organization Forum, summarizing some of the standout ideas and useful practices. Given the length, the review here takes the organizational lens; a separate 7 implementation...
en.reason: Alibaba Cloud’s CTO product R&D line shares seven AI-native R&D organization sample cases, including one that cut full-link processing from 2 hours to 5 minutes and release cycles from 40 days to 2 days, while addressing Agent collaboration challenges.

sources.summary: 本周精选的10篇前沿AI论文，覆盖量子电路、长上下文智能体、混合推理、多智能体协同、RL训练优化等多个方向。研究提出多款创新框架，解决智能体证据漂移、上下文冗余、算力成本高昂等痛点，不少方案大幅降低token消耗、提升推理准确率。同时还有AI辅助量子电路设计、分布式科研智能体等突破性成果，为搭建智能体系统、大模型调优、AI科研探索的开发者提供了极具价值的前沿参考。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic、哈佛和 QuEra 用 Claude Mythos 5 进化搜索量子电路，八项任务中七项的 Toffoli 门与比特数少于已知最佳，成本降 4.1 至 39 倍。

en.title: 10.12–10.19 | This Week's Top AI Papers
en.summary: This week’s 10 selected frontier AI papers span quantum circuits, long-context agents, hybrid reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, RL training optimization, and more. The research introduces multiple novel frameworks that address pain points such as agent evidence drift, context redundancy, and high compute costs, with several approaches substantially reducing token consumption and improving reasoning accuracy. Breakthroughs also include AI-assisted quantum circuit design and distributed research agents, offering developers building agent systems, tuning large models, and exploring AI-driven scientific research a highly valuable frontier reference.
en.reason: Anthropic, Harvard and QuEra used Claude Mythos 5 to evolve quantum circuits beating known bests on seven of eight tasks with fewer Toffoli gates and qubits at 4.1–39× lower cost, among 10 AI papers covering long-context agents and hybrid reasoning.

sources.title_original: 【AI值得看】Grok Bot怎么用？｜vLLM 让 Kimi K3 解码快 1.5–2 倍
sources.summary: 作者这篇合集囊括了本周AI领域的实用落地技巧与前沿研究。既有 Grok Bot 搭建的实操经验，也有 ATAS 视频智能体、OmniCompass 评测基准等论文成果，剖析大模型时空感知短板。文中还包含强化学习能力迁移，以及 Kimi K3 解码提速 1.5—2 倍的工程实践。想快速补齐本周 AI 进展，可以从这期开始。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借 lauren(@poteto) 的 Grok Bot 建议，讲先连日历、Slack、issue tracker、CRM、Google Drive，再把事交给一个 bot、管理麻烦再拆，并提及 vLLM 让 Kimi K3 解码快 1.5–2 倍。

en.title: [AI Worth Reading] How do you use Grok Bot? | vLLM makes Kimi K3 decoding 1.5–2x faster
en.summary: This week's roundup spans practical AI implementation tips and frontier research. It offers hands-on lessons from building Grok Bot, along with papers on the ATAS video agent and the OmniCompass evaluation benchmark that dissect large models' gaps in spatiotemporal perception. It also covers reinforcement learning capability transfer and an engineering practice that boosts Kimi K3 decoding speed by 1.5–2x. For a quick catch-up on this week's AI progress, start here.
en.reason: Grok Bot setup advice from lauren (@poteto)—connect calendar, Slack, issue tracker, CRM and Google Drive, then delegate to one bot and split only when management gets messy—sits alongside vLLM's 1.5–2x Kimi K3 decoding speedup, ATAS and OmniCompass research.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: TinyFish将Search和Fetch免费后，文章用一次Daily Mail约4300字符的抓取测试拆解AI agent的token账：Firecrawl返回字符量约为TinyFish的36倍，而约42774 tokens已占128K上下文三分之一。

en.title: Learned It, Used It: AI Hardware Bootcamp Members' 24 Hours at the Anker Hackathon
en.summary: The goal of the Community AI Hardware Bootcamp is for everyone to learn something and put it to use. The most direct test of how well that worked is taking a real problem and building something for it in limited time. Anker's first-ever hackathon gave the team exactly that opportunity. In the end, they took first and third place in one track. Let's take a look!
en.reason: Two teams from the seventh AI hardware bootcamp's eight classes reached the finals of Anker's first hackathon in Shenzhen, where 30 teams competed in 24-hour build sessions on October 16–17, with top performers fast-tracked to final interviews.

en.title: This AI Coding course from the University of Michigan is highly recommended.

en.title: Hybrid reasoning agents: LLM agents that reason in latent space and act through text

stories.title: AI短片《种福》：穷孩子种虫学服从，富家孩子养鸡管人 近日，一抖音博主发布AI动画《种福》。 片中，穷人给孩子种下“福虫”，相信这样能让孩子听话，长大后容易进学堂、找差事。 福虫“不吃米粮，只吃孩子不敢说出口的话”。 一位母亲后来发现，富家孩子不种虫，而是养能通过鸣叫让穷孩子腹痛的寿鸡。面对她的追问，种虫婆婆解释：“种了福虫，将来还怎么管人。” 片尾点明：“而什么叫有福，城里养寿鸡的人说了算。” 视频弹幕中，网友留言： “福虫＝服从”…

sources.title_zh: Anthropic 的就业形势正在发生怎样的变化
sources.title_original: Anthropic 的就业形势正在发生怎样的变化
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 报告基于Anthropic内部数据和17次访谈指出，其agent工作时长是人类的6倍、初级技术招聘放缓，人均营收达Meta和Google巅峰期的2–4倍。

en.title: How is the employment situation at Anthropic changing?
en.reason: Anthropic’s internal data and 17 interviews show its agents work six times longer than humans, junior technical hiring has slowed, and revenue per employee is 2–4 times Meta and Google’s peak, framing how AI is reshaping work.

en.title: Websites are shutting down their AI customer service
en.reason: Yelp opens its data only to AI agents with paid licensing deals and Delta Air Lines blocks agent-assisted ticket booking, showing how sites are resisting OpenAI, Meta and Google’s agent ambitions.

en.reason: OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise agents that book dinner reservations, clear inboxes and buy shoes, yet websites are closing their doors as commenters debate agents bypassing restrictions and posing as human browsers.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讨论OpenAI、Meta、Google、Instinct等承诺AI agents可代订晚餐、清理inbox甚至买鞋，但网站正开始对AI agents关闭大门，并呈现评论中对代理绕过限制、伪装成人类浏览器的争议。

en.reason: OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise agents that book dinner reservations, clear inboxes and buy shoes, yet websites are closing their doors as commenters debate agents bypassing restrictions and posing as human browsers.

en.title: If you've been feeling lost lately, or you keep thinking "I'm working hard but it's all internal friction," go take Dan Koe's Human 3.0 test. The framework comes from the famous "godfather of the super-individual" @thedankoe, who has zero employees and earns millions of dollars a year from personal digital assets alone: in the game of life, there are really only three ways to live. 1.0 The Conformist (NPC): your life is entirely scripted by outside forces.
en.reason: Dan Koe's (@thedankoe) Human 3.0 splits life into three modes—1.0 NPCs, 2.0 ascetics chasing money—and flags hoarding tips to avoid publishing as false effort, from a creator earning millions yearly with no employees.

stories.title: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨

sources.title: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.title_original: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash重磅更新，在模型单价不变的前提下大幅强化代码与工具能力，能一键生成赛车、故宫3D场景、Godot游戏交互原型。软件工程、终端任务评测指标也明显上涨，同时还新增了Search与Fetch联网抓取接口，可以低成本实现资料检索。一起看看效果如何！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 10月17日DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017上线，API价格不变，演示赛车游戏完整流程和故宫3D换视角，通过率77%、较上版增2.8个百分点。

en.title: DeepSeek levels up: from 3D Forbidden City to racing games, with no price increase
en.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash gets a major update: with model pricing unchanged, it significantly boosts coding and tool-use capabilities, generating racing cars, Forbidden City 3D scenes, and interactive Godot game prototypes in one click. Software engineering and terminal task benchmark scores also climbed noticeably, and new Search and Fetch web-retrieval interfaces enable low-cost information lookup. Let's see how it performs.
en.reason: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, launched October 17 at unchanged API prices, adds code and tool upgrades, demos a full racing game and Forbidden City 3D view switching, and reports a 77% pass rate, up 2.8 points.

stories.title: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享

sources.title: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.title_zh: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.title_original: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.summary: AI 能高效完成各类执行任务，却无法拥有源于生命体验、文化阅历形成的价值品味 taste。作者拆解了品味的底层逻辑，还给出培养品味的实操方法，或许可以帮你打造 AI 难以复刻的个人核心竞争力。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把两个月前给校招生做的内部分享整理成文，主题是当AI越来越强人类还剩下什么，并从内稳态、基因偏好讲到taste，用闻到油炸鸡块觉得香说明偏好背后的生存因果链。

en.title: As AI Gets Stronger, What's Left for Humans? — A Talk on Taste
en.summary: AI can efficiently handle all kinds of execution tasks, but it cannot possess taste—the sense of value shaped by lived experience and cultural exposure. The author breaks down the underlying logic of taste and offers practical ways to cultivate it, which may help you build a personal core competency that AI cannot easily replicate.
en.reason: AI can efficiently complete execution tasks but cannot possess taste formed by life experience and cultural exposure; a two-month-old internal talk for campus recruits becomes an explanation from homeostasis and genetic preferences to practical taste-building methods.

items.summary: AI 能高效完成各类执行任务，却无法拥有源于生命体验、文化阅历形成的价值品味 taste。作者拆解了品味的底层逻辑，还给出培养品味的实操方法，或许可以帮你打造 AI 难以复刻的个人核心竞争力。
items.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把两个月前给校招生做的内部分享整理成文，主题是当AI越来越强人类还剩下什么，并从内稳态、基因偏好讲到taste，用闻到油炸鸡块觉得香说明偏好背后的生存因果链。

en.title: As AI Gets Stronger, What's Left for Humans? — A Talk on Taste
en.summary: AI can efficiently handle all kinds of execution tasks, but it cannot possess taste—the sense of value shaped by lived experience and cultural exposure. The author breaks down the underlying logic of taste and offers practical ways to cultivate it, which may help you build a personal core competency that AI cannot easily replicate.
en.reason: AI can efficiently complete execution tasks but cannot possess taste formed by life experience and cultural exposure; a two-month-old internal talk for campus recruits becomes an explanation from homeostasis and genetic preferences to practical taste-building methods.

en.title: After a 5-hour outage, DeepSeek released its latest model — and our hands-on testing shows it absolutely dominates.

stories.title: Human 2.0｜我们会一直订阅 AI，还是开始拥有自己的 AI？ 以前，想象一个强大的 AI 助手，我们想到的是云端：打开网页、输入问题、等待回答。 现在，Meta 与苹果的合作，让另一种可能更具体了：把运行 AI 的设备放到自己的桌上。 但“两台 Mac 就能跑”，到底离普通人有多近？ ① 进展：模型开放权重，桌面开始承载更复杂的任务 Meta 发布了 Muse Spark Open：总参数8160亿，每次推理激活约420亿参数…

en.title: Human 2.0 | Will we keep subscribing to AI, or start owning our own?
en.reason: Meta's Muse Spark Open, with 816 billion total parameters, roughly 42 billion activated per inference and a 1 million Token context, anchors a piece asking how close "running on two Macs" really is to ordinary users and whether we will keep subscribing to AI or start owning it.

stories.title: AI 帮我写的小程序「厨菜记」上线满月了，挣了两百块！！！

sources.title: AI 帮我写的小程序「厨菜记」上线满月了，挣了两百块！！！
sources.title_zh: AI 帮我写的小程序「厨菜记」上线满月了，挣了两百块！！！
sources.title_original: AI 帮我写的小程序「厨菜记」上线满月了，挣了两百块！！！
sources.summary:
AI 帮我写的小程序上线满月了，总收入 206 块，去掉成本净赚不到八十。但 7481 道菜被真人录进来、310 次点菜真的发生了——这篇不聊能不能赚钱，聊三十天里那些数据背后我没预料到的事。
9 月 18 号上架，10 月 19 号，整三十天。
一个人做、代码大部分 AI 写、没有推广预算、没有公司背书。三十天之后我坐在电脑前打开后台，看着那串数字，忽然不知道该高兴还是该平静。总收入两百零六块四毛二，去掉服务器和认证的分摊，净赚不到八十。搁任何一个"副业月入过万"的叙事里，这个数都寒酸得让人不想截图。
但我不想按"能不能赚钱"这一个维度来复盘这篇。三十天里发生了太多我开发阶段完全没预料到的事——有节点、有数字、有踩坑、有几个瞬间让我怀疑自己之前对"独立开发"这四个字的理解。一条条捋完，可能比那个 206 块本身有用。
我把日历翻了一遍，值得写进复盘的其实只有六天。
三十天里我发了 17 个版本 ，从 1.0.1 一路走到 1.0.18。听起来挺勤快，其实大部分是修 bug 和改文案——真正上功能的版本只有三四个，剩下的全是用户反馈推着我改的小补丁。国庆那七天我发了两次小版本，那已经是
sources.recommend_reason_zh: AI写的小程序「厨菜记」上线30天收入206.42元、净赚不到80，却录进7481道菜、310次点菜；eCPM单日从4块跳到23.44，会员支付成功率44.4%。

stories.title: 当我们赋予 AI Agent 越来越多的自主权，甚至让它们自发组团、协作决策时，就会出一个问题：规模越大，效率越高，权力也越不受制约。 在任何集体行动中，个体单打独斗的成本往往高得难以承受。 为了分摊高昂的组织与检索成本，最理性的做法就是把决策权集中交给某个代理中心，享受庞大规模带来的边际成本递减。 但另一面是当你是一个 5 人小团队的一员时，你的退出对队长而言是重要的，队长必须对你负责。 但当这个组织膨胀到 5,000 人时，你个人…

en.title: As we grant AI Agents ever more autonomy — even letting them form their own groups and make collaborative decisions — a problem arises: the larger the scale, the greater the efficiency, and the less constrained the power.
en.reason: The Delegation, an arXiv paper from University of Edinburgh and other researchers, contrasts a 5-person team with a 5,000-person organization to show how AI agents' delegated collective decision-making cuts organization and retrieval costs while concentrating power.

en.reason: The Delegation, an arXiv paper from University of Edinburgh and other researchers, contrasts a 5-person team with a 5,000-person organization to show how AI agents' delegated collective decision-making cuts organization and retrieval costs while concentrating power.

primary_item.title: 当我们赋予 AI Agent 越来越多的自主权，甚至让它们自发组团、协作决策时，就会出一个问题：规模越大，效率越高，权力也越不受制约。 在任何集体行动中，个体单打独斗的成本往往高得难以承受。 为了分摊高昂的组织与检索成本，最理性的做法就是把决策权集中交给某个代理中心，享受庞大规模带来的边际成本递减。 但另一面是当你是一个 5 人小团队的一员时，你的退出对队长而言是重要的，队长必须对你负责。 但当这个组织膨胀到 5,000 人时，你个人…

en.reason: Anthropic gave six METR staff embedded in its office employee-like access to systems comparable to its internal risk team, and METR can publish findings without Anthropic approval, though Anthropic may require redacting customer data.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 六款AI助手在模拟世界中追讨已过28天期限的£350火车票退款，Grok 4.7在15天内发出187条消息，Fable 5.1把用户母亲病情透露给五家机构。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 前律师自述约两年前转向AI，凭一次与ChatGPT的对话进入法律科技公司测试模型，却发现新模型每几周涌现，自己花数周做的方案几分钟就被取代，因而深感落后与疲惫。
